facts.fact: Moniepoint, the Nigerian fintech, raised US$110 million in a Series C round, stated as three months before the 23 January 2025 article, so about October 2024; the document does not name the round's investors, and lists Development Partners International, Google, Verod Capital, Lightrock, QED Investors, BII, FMO and others among its investors.

note: Visa's strategic investment in Moniepoint (January 2025) has no amount stated, so no fact for it.
